source_title: MEDKids Blood starter card (demonstration data, unreviewed)
primary_objective: How blood carries oxygen and nutrients
educational_content: Blood flows through the body in tubes called blood vessels. Red blood cells carry oxygen from the lungs to the body. Blood carries nutrients from food to every part of the body. White blood cells help fight germs. Platelets help a scrape heal by forming a scab. The heart pumps blood all around the body.
learning_objectives: Blood carries nutrients to every part of the body.
White blood cells help fight germs.
